headline: Shanghai quarterfinal: Zverev beats de Minaur 6-4, 6-4
whyCareReason: ATP and the Rolex site both print 6-4, 6-4. Zverev is into Saturday's semifinal against Davidovich Fokina.
teaser: Top seed Alexander Zverev beat Alex de Minaur in 1 hour 17 minutes. He is the year-end No. 1. Sinner is out.
story: Alexander Zverev beat Alex de Minaur 6-4, 6-4 on Thursday 15 October at the Rolex Shanghai Masters. ATP Tour times the match at 1:17:34 on Stadium Court. The Rolex site records 10 aces and 35 of 44 first-serve points. Alejandro Davidovich Fokina waits in Saturday's semifinal after Arthur Gea retired at 4-1. Friday's other quarterfinals, Jodar against Ruud and Medvedev against Paul, have no posted score.
stakes: Zverev is one win from the final. The semifinal is Saturday against Davidovich Fokina.
rivalryAngle: Zverev leads the head-to-head with de Minaur 9-4 after this win, per the Rolex match report.
funFacts: Score: Zverev d. de Minaur 6-4, 6-4. Time 1:17:34. Umpire Adel Nour.
Saturday semifinal: Zverev vs Davidovich Fokina. Sinner is out for the season.
